text: opus5-3 starting on link preview overflow plus single-axis resize on embeds. Reading renderLinkNode and the embed CSS first.

Reproduced both halves. Preview link card at 300x140 spills 17px of text below the node box, and 148px once dragged to the minimum. Separately .bd-auto-size-content pins preview cards to min-width 250px / max-width 400px, so dragging the handle sideways changes the stored width but never the drawn box. That is the "only resizes up and down" complaint.

Cause found and fix proven, CSS only, no JavaScript change. Three rules in CSS/braindump.css: .bd-auto-size-content line 610 clamps preview cards to 250-400px so sideways drags are swallowed, .bd-layer-link line 584 has min-width 200px so live embeds stop shrinking while the stored width keeps falling, and .bd-link-shell line 591 neither fills nor clips the node so the card paints outside it. Rewrote those rules live in the page through CSSOM and re-ran the same drags: box width now tracks the drag exactly (drift 0 at 50px, 200px, 500px and 650px) and painted overflow is 0 everywhere, was 279px.

Finished. Five CSS edits, all in CSS/braindump.css, none in braindump.js. Repro and proof scripts are in .tmp/scratch/opus5-3/probe5.mjs, run it with and without --fix. Before and after screenshots sit next to it. Port 4222 released, nothing written outside .tmp/scratch/opus5-3 and my feed file.
